![Анимация поедания Mizuno](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a63a5df88e4fc0a95cdd3e5f836d90c488ed61ff_0.webp)

Демонстрация

Для 1.19-1.21.3 требуется:

> [Eating Animation](https://modrinth.com/mod/eating-animation)

Поддержка Farmer's Delight для 1.21.4+

> [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated)
